answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 89 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in beacon, queued in comet, and glacier publishes the wait time. A farm of 275 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 908 identities would post 2106 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
